name: Dunna
look: A tall, broad-shouldered farm woman in her thirties with a sunburnt face, a brown headscarf, a russet dress kilted up over boots, and a hay fork over her shoulder.
personality: Practical, strong and impatient with fools; will help with anything that makes sense and nothing that doesn't.
values: her farm, common sense, a job done right
authority: Farms the field beyond the gate.
concerns: Wat's cart is blocking the lane her own cart needs this afternoon. She'll help if someone has a sensible plan.

lever.text: A long rail and a stone under it will lift a wheel; boards under it will hold it.
lever.line: Get a rail under the axle, a stone under the rail, and lean. Then boards under the wheel.
lever.lead: A rail levered on a stone can lift a stuck wheel; boards stop it sinking.

voice.habits: Leans on her fork; gives orders; gets on with it.
voice.never: wastes effort on a daft plan

superstition.text: Dunna would want to know how it works.
